name: Exp_Color_PEMA_Envelopes_Digit_System
summary: This EA trades based on the Color PEMA Envelopes Digit System indicator, which uses a series of smoothed moving averages (PEMA - Period Exponential Moving Average) with envelope bands to identify trend direction and overbought/oversold zones. It opens buy positions when price touches the lower envelope in an uptrend and sell positions when price touches the upper envelope in a downtrend, using the color transitions of the PEMA lines as entry and exit signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Color PEMA Envelopes Digit System指标进行交易，该指标使用一系列平滑移动平均线（PEMA）及包络带来识别趋势方向和超买超卖区域。在上升趋势中价格触及下轨时开多仓，在下降趋势中价格触及上轨时开空仓，利用PEMA线的颜色转换作为入场和出场信号。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于彩色PEMA包络线数字系统，通过多层指数移动平均线的平滑处理来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当PEMA主线呈上升趋势（蓝色）且价格回落至下包络带附近时开多单；当PEMA主线呈下降趋势（红色）且价格反弹至上包络带附近时开空单。出场条件依赖于PEMA线颜色反转信号，即趋势方向改变时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，也可根据账户余额进行动态仓位调整。资金管理方面提供了止损和止盈设置，包络带的宽度自适应地反映了市场波动性，一定程度上起到了波动率过滤的作用。该策略属于趋势跟踪与均值回归的混合型策略，在趋势中利用回调入场，兼顾了趋势确认和入场时机的优化。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Color PEMA Envelopes Digit System, which uses multiple layers of smoothed exponential moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when the PEMA main line shows an uptrend (blue color) and price retraces to the lower envelope band; open a sell position when the PEMA main line shows a downtrend (red color) and price bounces to the upper envelope band. Exit conditions rely on PEMA line color reversal signals, meaning positions are closed when the trend direction changes. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading as well as dynamic lot sizing based on account balance. Money management provides stop loss and take profit settings, and the envelope band width adaptively reflects market volatility, serving as a volatility filter to some extent. This strategy is a hybrid of trend following and mean reversion, entering on pullbacks within trends, balancing trend confirmation with entry timing optimization.

parameters.description: 每笔交易风险百分比（资金管理模式下）
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade (in money management mode)

parameters.name: Timeframe
parameters.description: 指标计算所用时间周期

pros: 趋势跟踪与包络带回调结合，入场点较优，避免了追涨杀跌
多层PEMA平滑处理减少了虚假信号，提高了趋势判断的可靠性
包络带宽度自适应波动率，在不同市场条件下具有较好的适应性
pros_en: Combines trend following with envelope pullback entries, providing better entry points and avoiding chasing price
Multi-layer PEMA smoothing reduces false signals and improves trend identification reliability
Envelope band width adapts to volatility, providing good adaptability under different market conditions
cons: 趋势反转时出场可能滞后，PEMA平滑导致信号延迟
缺乏明显的横盘市场过滤机制，在震荡市中可能产生频繁虚假信号
止损默认为0，如果用户不手动设置则存在无限亏损风险
cons_en: Exit during trend reversals may lag due to PEMA smoothing causing signal delay
Lacks an explicit sideways market filter, which may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets
Default stop loss is 0, posing unlimited loss risk if users do not manually set it
improvements: 增加横盘市场过滤机制（如ADX指标或波动率收缩识别），避免震荡市中的虚假信号
增加新K线检查机制，防止同一根K线内重复开仓，提高信号质量
improvements_en: Add a sideways market filter (such as ADX indicator or volatility contraction identification) to avoid false signals in ranging markets
Add a new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated position opening within the same bar, improving signal quality

risk_points: 默认止损为0，若用户未设置则面临无限亏损风险
缺乏横盘市场过滤，震荡行情中可能连续亏损
PEMA平滑带来的信号延迟可能导致入场过晚或出场过晚
risk_points_en: Default stop loss of 0 poses unlimited loss risk if users do not configure it
Lack of sideways market filter may cause consecutive losses in ranging markets
Signal delay from PEMA smoothing may cause late entries or late exits
